system.description: The spectral armor of a Warhaunt is nigh impervious to all but a few modes of damage.

A mighty axe that saps surrounding magic to fuel its own power.

Breaker against all spell types. Must deal Ice damage when attacking at range. Spd -4 when attacking at range.
This unit can pass through other units and does not block the movement of other units.
As a Bonus Action, teleport to an unoccupied square within 5 Rng. Ignores LoS.
